name: Campingplatz Bad Neunbrunnen
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Bad Neunbrunnen is situated in the tranquil village of Maishofen, nestled within the striking alpine panorama of the Pinzgau. The location serves as an ideal base for mountain hikes, bike tours, and trips to nearby Lake Zeller See. Amenities include a private natural swimming lake, up-to-date sanitary facilities, a food store, and an on-site restaurant. Generous, partly terraced pitches offer abundant privacy and scenic mountain vistas for families, couples, and active holidaymakers.
